revision.text:
{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.

While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.

== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Wood * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Zhen (震) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Jia (甲), Yi (乙) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Mao (卯) * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of {{ill|lightning|ja|雷}}), {{ill|wave motion|ja|波動}} (such as {{ill|sound waves|ja|音波}} and {{ill|radio waves|ja|電波}}), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}}
== Years in Which Sanpeki Mokusei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 8 are Sanpeki Mokusei years.
‥‥ - [[1934]] - [[1943]] - [[1952]] - [[1961]] - [[1970]] - [[1979]] - [[1988]] - [[1997]] - [[2006]] - [[2015]] - [[2024]] - [[2033]] - [[2042]] - [[2051]] - [[2060]] - [[2069]] - ‥‥

'''三碧木星'''（さんぺきもくせい）とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。後天定位盤において東に位置する。
四緑木星と同じ木に属するが、三碧木星は、木としてはまだ若くこれから成長する木を表すという。
日の九星においては、夏至前後に九星の閏を置く場合、その期間中の甲午の日を三碧として陽遁から陰遁に切り替わる。その際前の陽遁最終日と合わせて三碧が2日続く。
==属性== *[[五行思想|五行]] - 木 *[[八卦]] - 震 *[[十干]] - 甲、乙 *[[十二支]] - 卯 *季節 - 春 *方位 - 東 *月 - 3月 *時間 - 5時～7時 *数 - 三、八 *色 - 青色 *味 - 酸味
==象意== *激しい、動く、繁栄、明朗、指揮者、管理職、宣伝、メッセージ、連絡、通信、交信 *音、声、音楽、評判、雷鳴（[[雷]]の音）、[[波動]]（[[音波]]や[[電波]]などの波全般）、地震、電気
==他の星との関係（相性）== *相生 - [[一白水星]]（水生木）、[[九紫火星]]（木生火） *相克 - [[二黒土星]]（木剋土）、[[五黄土星]]（木剋土）、[[六白金星]]（金剋木）、[[七赤金星]]（金剋木）、[[八白土星]]（木剋土） *比和 - 三碧木星、[[四緑木星]]
==三碧木星の（中宮になる）年== 西暦年を9で割って8余る年が三碧木星の年となる。
‥‥ - [[1934年]] - [[1943年]] - [[1952年]] - [[1961年]] - [[1970年]] - [[1979年]] - [[1988年]] - [[1997年]] - [[2006年]] - [[2015年]] - [[2024年]] - [[2033年]] - [[2042年]] - [[2051年]] - [[2060年]] - [[2069年]] - ‥‥

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square |- | 4 || 9 || 2 |- | style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 || 7 |- | 8 || 1 || 6 |}
{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Zhèn (Bagua)|ja|震|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen (震)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|zh|甲|hak|Kap (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kinoe|ko|갑 (천간)|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|za|Gyap (diengan)|zh-classical|甲|zh-min-nan|Kah (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|甲 (天干)|zh|甲 (天干)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|zh|乙|gan|乙|hak|Yet (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|vi|Ất|za|Iet (diengan)|zh-min-nan|It (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|乙|zh|乙|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Rabbit (zodiac)|Rabbit (卯)]] * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Sanpeki Mokusei, {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Zhèn (Bagua)|ja|震|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen (震)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|zh|甲|hak|Kap (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kinoe|ko|갑 (천간)|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|za|Gyap (diengan)|zh-classical|甲|zh-min-nan|Kah (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|甲 (天干)|zh|甲 (天干)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|zh|乙|gan|乙|hak|Yet (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|vi|Ất|za|Iet (diengan)|zh-min-nan|It (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|乙|zh|乙|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Rabbit (zodiac)|Rabbit (卯)]] * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Water generates Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Zhèn (Bagua)|ja|震|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen (震)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|zh|甲|hak|Kap (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kinoe|ko|갑 (천간)|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|za|Gyap (diengan)|zh-classical|甲|zh-min-nan|Kah (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|甲 (天干)|zh|甲 (天干)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|zh|乙|gan|乙|hak|Yet (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|vi|Ất|za|Iet (diengan)|zh-min-nan|It (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|乙|zh|乙|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Rabbit (zodiac)|Rabbit (卯)]] * Season - Spring * Direction - East * Month - March * Time - 5:00–7:00 * Number - Three, Eight * Color - Blue * Taste - Sour
== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity
