{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Intense, movement, prosperity, cheerfulness, leadership, managerial positions, publicity, messages, communication, correspondence * Sound, voice, music, reputation, thunder (sound of [[:en:Lightning|lightning]]), [[:en:Wave|wave motion]] (such as [[:en:Acoustic wave|sound waves]] and [[:en:Radio wave|radio waves]]), earthquakes, electricity

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square |- | 4 || 9 || 2 |- | style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 || 7 |- | 8 || 1 || 6 |}
{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Sanpeki is in the center |- | 2 || 7 || 9 |- | 1 || style="background-color:#FF80C0;" | 3 || 5 |- | 6 || 8 || 4 |}
'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Sanpeki Mokusei''' (三碧木星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the eastern position.
While it belongs to the same Wood element as {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}}, Sanpeki Mokusei represents young trees that are still growing, as opposed to mature ones.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the summer solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Sanpeki, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Sanpeki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
